positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceValue
positions.frame: what distinguishes owned intelligence from rented intelligence, and which layer — substrate or perspective — counts as the kept asset?
positions.why: Both expressions are plain-spoken maxims performing the same directional move: a categorical opposition (owned/rented, commodity/asset) that elevates perspective to a retained, identity-level good while treating substrate as fungible. src-2 states the general distinction; src-3 sharpens it into the specific substrate-vs-perspective partition. Read together under one frame; no tension between them, just increasing specificity.
